label.title: Brute Force Login Protection
label.description: Protect your Jahia server from brute-force login attacks by automatically blocking IP addresses after a configurable number of failed login attempts.
label.whitelistIpsTooltip: Provide a comma-separated list of CIDRs (e.g. 127.0.0.1/32, 192.168.0.0/24)
label.saveError: An error occurred while saving the settings.
label.errorWhitelistRequired: The whitelist cannot be empty when the service is activated. At least one CIDR (e.g. 127.0.0.1/32) is required.
label.flushDescription: Clear the protection cache to force settings reload and reset blocked IP counters.
label.flushError: An error occurred while flushing the cache.
